verdict.rationale: Graphite's own docs show that AI reviews can be turned on across an entire organization or for selected repositories. Custom rules and comment exclusions shape how the review agent behaves. That gives an org-level AI-review default with repo-level selection, but the evidence does not show centralized policy inheritance or exception management for general review settings at scale. Missing for 10: org-wide review policy defaults beyond AI-review enablement, a central exception or override management model, evidence that rules and exclusions are applied org-wide versus per repo, and independent corroboration at hundreds-of-repos scale.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I roll out org-level review defaults across hundreds of repos and manage exceptions centrally

citations.quote: You can choose specific repositories or enable AI reviews across your entire organization
Graphite Agent will now automatically review all new pull requests in the selected repositories
Custom rules allow you to define explicit guidelines for Graphite Agent to follow when reviewing your code.
Comment exclusions allow you to specify situations where Graphite Agent should not leave comments.
